notes.title: 🥂 This Bed We Made Nominated for Multiple Awards
notes.notes:
Hello, Bedheads!

We're thrilled to share some incredible news: [i]This Bed We Made[/i] has been nominated for several prestigious awards!

🏳️‍🌈 GLAAD Media Award Nomination
We're honored to be recognized for our dedication to the 2SLGBTQIA+ community. A heartfelt thank you to GLAAD for this nomination!

🎮 Triple Nomination at the Gayming Awards 2024
Exciting times continue with THREE nominations at the Gayming Awards: Best LGBTQ Indie Game, Gayming Magazine Readers' Award, and Authentic Representation Award.

📖 Best Narrative Nomination by Debug Magazine
Our journey in storytelling is further celebrated with a Best Narrative nomination from Debug Magazine. This means the world to us.

Special shoutout to @Krystine_art for the incredible portrait of Sophie, which graces our cover picture. We love it so so so much!

A HUGE thank you to our community. Your support makes all of this possible (and that's an understatement). 

Stay tuned for more updates, and let's hope for some wins!

With gratitude and excitement,
The Lowbirth Team ❤️

notes.title: This Bed We Made review
notes.notes: t time of writing, I’ve never been employed as a space marine, supersoldier, bard, Spider-Man, or most of the jobs that character’s in video games tend to have. But in This Bed We Made you play as Sophie, a maid in a 1950’s hotel. I have worked as a cleaner in a hotel, so I speak with some authority when I say that Sophie should be fired immediately... Read more.

notes.title: This cool 50s noir game lets you do the job of a hotel cleaner (aka: solve a mystery)
notes.notes:
You know who you shouldn't trust? Hotel cleaners. Not in real life, I should add - where they are hardworking and one time one helped me catch and kill cockroach even though we didn't speak the same language - but in the game This Bed We Made, a third person mystery set in a slightly grimy 1950s hotel. The reason why you shouldn't trust this particular cleaner because it is, in fact, you, in the kitten heels of Sophie here, as you rifle through their belongings and ogle at their undies. There's a demo of one such room on Steam now, and it plops you right in medias of some juicy res.

Read more
